subject: genetics
question: **Type:** application A human spermatocyte with 46 chromosomes (2n = 46) completes meiosis I without any errors. What is the chromosome content of each of the two daughter cells produced at the end of meiosis I?

options.text: 46 chromosomes, each with two sister chromatids
23 chromosomes, each with two sister chromatids

explanation: Meiosis I is the reductional division: homologous chromosomes separate, so the chromosome number is cut in half, from 46 to 23 chromosomes per daughter cell. Sister chromatids remain joined through meiosis I, so each of the 23 chromosomes still carries two chromatids. Option D describes the post-meiosis II products, and options A and B keep the diploid count instead of halving it.
